a1.say: Let's solve Hidden Inside Another String, using the Two Pointers approach.

a1.cap: Return true if you can obtain s from t by deleting some (or no) characters of t without reordering the rest — in other words, if s is a subsequence of t.

lines: Return true if you can obtain s from t by deleting some (or no) characters of t without reordering the rest — in other words, if s is a subsequence of t.

a1.cap: For example, with s = "ace", t = "abcde", the answer is true.
a1.say: For example, with s equals "ace", t equals "abcde", the answer is true.

a1.cap: Pointer I tracks the next character of s we still need; pointer J scans t.
Whenever t[j] equals the needed character, I moves forward. If I reaches the end of s, every character was found in order.
a1.say: Whenever t at j equals the needed character, I moves forward. If I reaches the end of s, every character was found in order.
